construction: Only explicitly selected aggregate counts, source-code/release pins, scope statements and historical command templates. No raw rows, household identifiers, source dictionaries, frame pickle/parquet bytes, complete warnings, traces or strict failure details are included.
raw_and_complete_operands: Retained only in the private manifest payload.
export_scope: Only these eight literal files named in ALLOWLIST.json; private manifest/READY/control records are for root authentication.
